text_block_list.name: Urara & Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ready, set! Shakur-san, happy, birthday to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Bwah-gahh!! I-I-I'm so sorry...!! B-B-But, 
you see, Urara-san came up with something, 
and, uh, well...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Shakur-san, it must be exhausting staring 
down your computer all the time, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"They say at times like that, you should 
look at distant greenery! Greenery can 
also mean nature, right? So, you know..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look at Digi-chan and me! Early spring is 
here~♪ Urara~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-Whaaaaat...?! That was the reason...?! 
H-H-How can she be so blindingly pure...! 
May Urara's blessings shine upon the 
world...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(However, her partner is the pitch-black 
Shakur-san... She might be completely 
incompatible with Urara-san's radiant 
light—)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dummy, don't go getting any weird ideas.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the whole point is that it's 
green, right? Plus, looking into the 
distance relaxes the ciliary musclesâ 
Ah, meaning, it's double useless in this 
case.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then I'll wave from afar! Let's go, 
Digi-chan! ..................Digi-chan?
